evidence.quote: I believe that, with a strong economy and a solid labor market, we can take our time to assess the incoming data to make any further adjustments to our policy rate.
Progress toward our 2 percent objective has been slow in the past year. I expect the path of inflation to continue to be bumpy.
The performance of the U.S. economy has been quite strong overall.
These indicators suggest that certain groups of households may have a hard time weathering unexpected costs or economic shocks.
While a cumulative cut in the policy rate by 100 basis points last year has brought the stance of monetary policy closer to a neutral setting, monetary policy continues to be restrictive.
